tools.name: get_github_stats
tools.description: A GitHub user's stats: contributions in the last 12 months and all time (year by year), longest and current streak, biggest day, commits/PRs/reviews/issues since joining, top languages by code size and most-starred repositories.

tools.name: get_github_wrapped
tools.description: A GitHub user's year in review: contributions and active days, longest streak, busiest day, month and weekday, top repositories and languages, achievements and a one-line persona.

tools.name: compare_github_profiles
tools.description: Two GitHub users' year side by side: contributions, active days, streaks, busiest month, work by type and top language.

tools.name: get_readme_card
tools.description: The Markdown line that puts GitShine's animated stats card (contribution graph, streaks, stars, top languages) on a GitHub profile README, with step-by-step instructions for adding it. Free, no token.
